newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.68 pct at Italy mark repo.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.68 pct at Italy mark repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 3.0 billion mark Bank of Italy one-month repurchase tender was 7.68 percent against 8.25 percent at the previous foreign currency tender for one month, the Bank said.
The average indicative rate was 7.69 percent from 8.25 percent at a previous tender for $3.0 billion on October 10.
A Bank statement said the tender was fully subscribed and the funds assigned at a minimum 3.94 forward points above the 1,007.50 lire per mark floor set by the Bank of Italy.
The Bank received 28 bids of which four were met in full and one in part.
